description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator classes for null, carriage return, and line feed, as well as a template class for stream text handling with customizable terminators. It provides mechanisms for handling text input/output, termination detection, and data conversion, intended for use within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: TerminatorNull
classes.description: Class for handling null character termination detection.

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturn
classes.description: Class for handling newline character termination detection.

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturnLineFeed
classes.description: Class for handling CRLF sequence termination detection.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including nested HandlerType for event handling and data transfer.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Detects if a character signifies termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if the stream is idle.
